title: 第一卷 第13章 进入营中第一卷 第14章 临时行动
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
回到家中，李月和李信看着哥哥带回来的猎物惊讶不已。
李信立马按照李毅的吩咐，跑去隔壁叫刘茹过来帮忙。
一家人忙忙碌碌的，花了大半天的时间，才把猎物处理好。
之后李毅亲自去了趟李二牛那，给他送了点肉，顺便跟他说了下明天去入营的事，让他帮忙照顾下家里。
李二牛自然是满口答应，他现在就指望着李毅能和刘芳生个孩子。
回到家中后，李毅没有休息，争分夺秒地练习起自己的技能。
每积攒一点经验，之后在战场存活的可能性就能高上一分。
-----------------
次日一早，李毅拿着准备好的干粮跟身份牌，天还没亮，就离开家门，往军营走去。
军营在黑石镇东北处，距离县城不到五里路。
已经在这驻扎一月有余，这段时间一直在扩充兵力。
进了里边的，基本很少有能活着回去。
李毅来到军营门口时，外面已经排起了长龙，这些人显然跟他一样，都是被抓壮丁的。
不然好端端的，谁愿意上战场当炮灰？
李毅排了好一会，期间一直在脑中思考着八极大枪是不是能和【裂风破阵枪】结合起来。
结果不知不觉就轮到了他。
“姓名。”
“李毅。”
“新兵没有月饷，先进入大营，等考核后再分配，现在去旁边领取衣物后等着。”
整套流程下来，不到一刻钟。

李毅领取到了一套发黑的破烂军服，还有一个护额。
明显是老兵淘汰下来的。
就在李毅想着怎么去大营报道的时候，一道声音从旁边传了过来。
“李毅，是你？”
李毅转过头去，看到一个虎背熊腰的壮汉，正瞪大眼睛看着他。
“韩甲？”
韩甲，黑石镇人，从小就是个小胖墩，跟李毅一起长大，只是后来随着其父亲离开，一直没有音讯。
“真的是你，我都差点认不出你了，小时候那么瘦。”
韩甲走过来用力抱了下李毅后，在他胸口锤了一拳，道：“现在长得又高又壮，你是怎么做到的？”
李毅笑着道：“男大十九变嘛，吃的多了，自然会长个子。”
俩人很快就聊了起来，在这种地方遇到熟人，也算是不幸中的万幸。
聊了一阵后，李毅便知道了韩甲的情况。
原来他离开之后，便去了隔壁镇投靠舅舅。
这才官府到处抓壮丁，韩甲也没逃过。
不过因为他舅舅曾在军营待过，让他懂的东西比其他人多不少。
李毅立马询问起他关于军中的情况。
还有一点就是，他想知道这个世界的修炼体系。
content_en:
Back home, Li Yue and Li Xin were surprised to see the prey brought back by their brother.
Li Xin immediately followed Li Yi's instructions and ran to the next door to ask Liu Ru to come over and help.
The family was busy and spent most of the day handling the prey.
Afterwards, Li Yi personally went to Li Erniu's place and gave him some meat. By the way, he told him about going to the camp tomorrow and asked him to help take care of the family.
Li Erniu naturally agreed. He was now counting on Li Yi and Liu Fang to have a child.
After returning home, Li Yi did not rest and raced against time to practice his skills.
Every time you accumulate experience, your chances of surviving on the battlefield will increase by one point.
------------------
Early the next morning, Li Yi took the prepared dry food and identity tags and left the house before dawn and walked to the military camp.
The military camp is located northeast of Heishi Town, less than five miles away from the county seat.
We have been stationed here for more than a month and have been expanding our troops during this time.
Basically, very few of those who go inside make it back alive.
When Li Yi came to the gate of the military camp, there was already a long queue outside. These people were obviously captured as young men like him.
Otherwise, who would be willing to go to the battlefield and be cannon fodder?
Li Yi lined up for a long time, during which he kept thinking about whether the Baji Gun could be combined with the [Splitting Wind Breaking Gun].
As a result, it was his turn before he knew it.
"Name."
"Li Yi."
"New recruits do not receive monthly salary. They must enter the camp first and then be assigned after the assessment. Now go to the side to collect their clothes and wait."
The whole process takes less than a quarter of an hour.
Li Yi received a set of blackened and tattered military uniforms and a forehead protector.
They were obviously eliminated by veterans.
Just when Li Yi was thinking about how to report to the camp, a voice came from the side.
"Li Yi, is that you?"
Li Yi turned around and saw a strong man with a strong back and a strong back, looking at him with wide eyes.
"Han Jia?"
Han Jia, a native of Blackstone Town, has been a chubby boy since he was a child. He grew up with Li Yi, but later his father left and there was no news from him.
"It's really you. I almost didn't recognize you. You were so thin when you were a kid."
Han Jia came over and hugged Li Yi hard, punched him in the chest and said, "You are now taller and stronger. How did you do that?"
Li Yi smiled and said: "Men will change in their 19th century. If you eat more, you will naturally grow taller."
The two soon started chatting. Meeting an acquaintance in a place like this was considered a blessing in misfortune.
After chatting for a while, Li Yi learned about Han Jia's situation.
It turned out that after he left, he went to the next town to seek refuge with his uncle.
Only then did the government arrest strong men everywhere, and Han Jia did not escape.
But because his uncle had stayed in a military camp, he knew a lot more than others.
Li Yi immediately asked him about the situation in the army.
Another point is that he wants to know the cultivation system of this world.
